snippet.title: Vivid Knight PV
snippet.description:
Vivid Knight, the best-selling game on Steam and Nintendo Switch, will finally be available on Google Play and App Store from February 17, 2022.The game will be available in over 170 countries and regions worldwide for USD 10.99. There are no additional fees after purchasing the game.

■ What is Vivid Knight?
Join forces with knights transformed into jewels by the Black Witch and combine their abilities to build an unbeatable party in this roguelike adventure.
Explore randomly-generated dungeons and defeat the bosses lurking on the lower floors!

Now Playable in English,Chinese,Korean,Russian and Spanish!

・Official WEB Site : https://www.asobism.co.jp/vividknight/
・Official Twitter : https://twitter.com/VividKnight_O
・Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569090/Vivid_Knight/
・Nintendo Switch : https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/vivid-knight-switch/
・App Store : https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vivid-knight/id1592050851
・Google Play : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.asobism.VividKnight2&hl=en&gl=us
